directions.name: The Pristine Productivity Engine
directions.rationale: A safe, industry-standard approach focusing on maximum legibility and frictionless task management. It uses a clean grid and subtle depth to make the UI feel fast and professional.

directions.name: Glass Morphic Focus
directions.rationale: A modern, trend-forward direction using translucency and vibrant accents to create a premium, 'Apple-like' aesthetic. It emphasizes visual delight while maintaining high hierarchy clarity.

directions.name: Neo-Tactile Workspace
directions.rationale: A disruptive, unique brand voice that uses bold typography and tactile 'clay' elements. It breaks away from traditional flat design to create a memorable, tactile interaction experience.
